source.units: cm in source (superscript digits are decimals: 8² = 8.2, 2⁵ = 2.5); model in mm

published_properties_note: The catalogue prints no area/centroid/inertia; validation is analytic (chain closure and tangent residuals). Somaco GP 42/52 volume/length (separate producer, includes end blocks) is not used.

conventions: 14 cm = theoretical sharp intersection of the tapered stem faces (22 cm at 37 cm above soffit) with the lower-flange slope (from x = 30, y = 10) at y = 17; the vector outline's straight segments extrapolate to 13.6 cm there (drawing slightly anisotropic: drawn depth 41.6 cm).
'5' read as R = 50 mm, inscribed tangent to both straight faces (tangent points about 45 mm from the corner; vector drawing's Bezier ends 36-52 mm from it).

Stem width at the 17 cm level is NOT printed; 14 cm copied from Grindă pod 42 (ESTIMATE). The vector outline scales about 12.6 cm (stem taper extrapolated) and its lower-flange slope is steeper (0.37 vs 0.29) than on 42, so the drawn 52 is not a simple extension of 42.
Same R = 50 mm construction as 42.

printed_cm.strand_view_width_conflict: strand-position view prints 90 cm; section prints 92 cm (geometry follows the dimensioned section)

conventions: Straight segments kept as printed: top slope from the 8 cm edge (x = 51) falling 8.2 cm to the knee at x = 13.5 + 4 = 17.5; lower slope from the flange edge (x = 46, y = 11).

R = 50 mm kept exact. Upper fillet tangent to the web and to the sloping flange (slope 8.2/33.5, 13.75 deg): horizontal extent 38.1 mm (printed 40), vertical extent 48.5 mm (printed 48), web tangent 1.0 mm below the printed level. The earlier 48.8 mm radius figure (visual-followup-za-ro-nepal.md) assumed a horizontal flange tangent and is superseded.

Lower fillet: circle R = 50 mm tangent to the web with its web tangent point at the printed 2.5+8.5+8+5 = 24 cm level; the lower-flange straight face is the tangent from the flange edge (46, 11). Its fillet tangent point lies at y = 191.9 mm vs the printed 19 cm (1.9 mm residual). The lower slope's horizontal extent is not printed.
Residual <= 2 mm on every printed fillet extent; area effect << 0.1%.

Chosen reading: the first vertical label (10 on 95, 12 on 105) is the flange-EDGE thickness, followed by the 2 cm flange-underside drop to the knee, then the 10 cm fillet zone. Only this reading closes 10+2+10+39.5+21.5+12 = 95 and 12+2+10+44.5+24.5+12 = 105. The vector drawings are drawn about 2 cm shallower (93 and 103 cm total, edges 8 and 10 cm), i.e. with the other reading; the stated depth governs.

Top fillet R = 100 mm tangent to the web and the 2 cm/42 cm (95) or 2/40 (105) sloping underside; vertical extent 99.9 mm (printed 100), web tangent within 0.1 mm of the printed level; horizontal extent 95.2 mm (95) / 95.0 mm (105) vs printed 100 (about 5 mm residual, because the printed 10 cm is measured to the theoretical knee).
